Method of Attack: Remote Code Execution (RCE) exploiting lack of input sanitization of '#' character in URLs
Exploitation leading to backdoors, coinminers, web-based ransomware, tech support scam redirections, defacements
Attack Vector: Exploitation of 'destination' GET query parameter accepting unsanitized URL with '#' character
Weaponized proof-of-concept code published on Pastebin
Indicators of Compromise: In-the-wild attacks reported five hours after patch release
